exposure: Infant age (less than 1 month, 1-2 months, 3-4 months, 5-6 months)
cohort: 400 mother-infant pairs attending the infant welfare clinic of the Nnamdi Azikiwe University teaching hospital (NAUTH) during 2012
finding: Despite high awareness and knowledge of exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) among mothers in Nnewi, south-east Nigeria, the practice of EBF was low, and maternal education, socioeconomic class, mode of delivery, and infant's first feed were significant predictors of EBF practice.
mod_finding: Mothers who delivered through caesarean section were less likely to practice EBF.
followup_time: Infants below six months of age
